title: Vibrant Springy Turkish Pork Belly Kebabs
description: A sour and springy Turkish dish featuring pork belly slices, perfect for a monsoon evening, made with a deglaze-fond and gluten-free-friendly ingredients. This recipe combines the richness of pork belly with the brightness of spring flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, pomegranate molasses, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced pork belly to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork belly slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the kebabs are cooking, prepare the deglaze-fond by reducing 1/4 cup of pomegranate molasses and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the kebabs are cooked, brush them with the deglaze-fond and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
